proof_roadmap: Flatness via the cut lemma (proof lines 8076-8077).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that cutting a flat finite presentation algebra by a sequence whose images form a quasi-regular sequence, given that the quotient is smooth, produces again a smooth algebra, under the assumption that the kernel ideal is locally nilpotent. The proof records that the quotient is still of finite presentation, uses the flatness statement for cuts by quasi-regular sequences to get flatness, observes that the fibre rings of the cut algebra agree with those of the quotient, which are smooth by hypothesis, and concludes smoothness from the flat-fibre criterion.
